title: 1 Trillion Phone Calls/yr, 10% Error rate: The Crisis in Voice AI — Sumanyu Sharma, Hamming AI
talk_summary: A voice-AI reliability founder argues that production agents fail at ~10% error rate and that the fix is a disciplined loop: identify failure modes, prioritize by frequency×severity, fix, then verify with replayed and varied synthetic conversations plus A/B tests, and keep monitoring. He also stresses cross-conversation analysis to discover novel failure patterns and continuous adversarial red-teaming.

takeaways.what_they_do: After a fix, replay the exact failing conversation many times to estimate pass probability, then keep the same intent but vary wording/style/accents and add extra intents to test generalization.
takeaways.evidence_quote: replay that exact conversation and run that maybe 5, 10, 20, 50 times and see, okay, what is my probability of passing

takeaways.what_they_do: Classify problems on two axes (one-off vs systematic, low vs high impact) and treat systematic+high-impact as P0, while not ignoring systematic low-impact issues in bake-offs.
takeaways.evidence_quote: systematic and high impact are obviously the P 0 you know target areas

takeaways.what_they_do: Analyze across many runs, not single runs, to discover emerging failure patterns that per-run scoring misses; combine manual listening, rubric spreadsheets, and LLM-as-judge at scale.
takeaways.evidence_quote: We're spending a ton of time on performing cross conversation analysis, not a pattern on a single call, but across conversations.

takeaways.what_they_do: Run 24/7 red-teaming against agents, especially where bad interactions are costly; they broke 1 in 5 agents and bypassed verification.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we can probably break one in five agents at this point

takeaways.technique: A/B test what simulation can't cover
takeaways.what_they_do: For hypotheses hard to validate synthetically (e.g., first 5 seconds of outbound calls), use real A/B tests rather than simulation alone.
takeaways.evidence_quote: AB testing ends up being, you know, pretty pretty critical for those circumstances

takeaways.technique: Identify→prioritize→fix→verify→monitor loop as an explicit pipeline
takeaways.what_they_do: Treat fixing as the cheapest step and invest most effort in verification and post-deploy monitoring; loop back continuously.
takeaways.evidence_quote: attempting to make a fix is the simplest and the lowest effort component of this debugging pipeline
